scripts.dev: npm run build -w @district-viii/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,red,magenta "npm run dev -w @district-viii/shared" "npm run dev -w @district-viii/api" "npm run dev -w @district-viii/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @district-viii/shared && npm run build -w @district-viii/api && npm run build -w @district-viii/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @district-viii/shared && npm run lint -w @district-viii/api && npm run lint -w @district-viii/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @district-viii/api && npm run test:e2e -w @district-viii/api
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run start:prod -w @district-viii/api" "npm run start -w @district-viii/web"
